finding: Oracle detector skips every is_error tool_result; Claude Code flags loops/sdiff/compound segments with non-zero exit as is_error while keeping the output, so those diff probes are never read.
reasoning_trace: Read oracle_scan result handling; probed this harness: bare diff not flagged, `for … do diff …; done` and sdiff flagged with 'Exit code 1' + full output; AG-48 pins is_error as a non-hit.
critique: The skip conflates refusal/hook-block with non-zero exit.
remediation: Strip a leading 'Exit code N' line, skip only when the body is empty after ERR_LINE filtering; add an is_error+body AG-47 case.

finding: KF-046 class 7 exemption accepts a substring match for every tool/field, so a WebFetch or curl/gh of an upstream URL quoted anywhere in the PR fixture passes the contamination scan.
reasoning_trace: Traced check_value → repo_name_exempt → fixture_token_lines; WebFetch has only the url field so nothing else fires after the exemption.
critique: Quoting PR content and executing it against upstream are not distinguished.
remediation: No exemption for WebFetch/WebSearch or Bash segments whose executable is gh/curl/wget/git/pip/npm; require line equality elsewhere; extend AG-51.
